contracts.serialization: Word UTF8 w:token; character UTF8 c: then scalar tag0+uint32LE or BOS tag1/EOS tag2; bigram ASCII b: then uint32LE UTF8 length+bytes of left and right bounded tokens
contracts.hash: FNV1a32 unsigned, bucket rawHash & (familyBuckets-1), repeats retained
contracts.pooling: 0.5*(word+char), word=0.75*unigramMean+0.25*orderedBigramMean if any bigrams else unigramMean; character family mean; L2 normalize
contracts.candidateComposition: Mean valid label/alias vectors, add0.25context vector, then normalize; experiment accepts label-only candidates
